journey.name: spending confirm amount change
journey.description:
Verifies that a transfer to spending never pays more than the total Spending Confirm shows (synonymdev/bitkit-ios#783). After the swipe creates the order, the funding is rebuilt for it. A plan that costs the same or less than the screen pays on that swipe. A plan that costs more pays nothing: the screen shows the new amounts, a "Fees changed" toast explains the increase, and the next swipe pays them.
This journey covers the cheaper plan. Spending Confirm sizes the network fee for two inputs, then a larger UTXO confirms before the swipe, so the plan rebuilt at swipe spends one input, costs less and pays at once. The higher-total path (the "Fees changed" toast) is covered by unit tests and a manual test, because spending the wallet's own UTXO outside the app is not a listed capability.
iOS differs from Android in one step: there is no app-log step.
Precondition: a freshly onboarded Debug build on the staging regtest backend (a plain Debug build, or an E2E_BUILD with E2E_BACKEND=network; the default E2E_BUILD targets the local backend, which cannot open a Blocktank channel) with no channel and exactly two confirmed on-chain UTXOs of 150 000 sats each (two ../bitkit-android/lsp deposits to the wallet's savings address, each followed by a mine). Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap Receive (id "Receive"), tap the "Savings" receive tab if one is shown, tap "Show Details" (id "ShowDetails"), read the address from id "ReceiveOnchainAddress", then close the sheet to return to the home screen
Tap the Savings balance card (id "ActivitySavings"), then "Transfer To Spending" (id "TransferToSpending")
If the spending intro appears, tap "Get Started" (id "SpendingIntroContinue")
Enter 200 000 on the number pad (ids "N2", "N0", "N0", "N0", "N0", "N0") and tap "Continue" (id "SpendingAmountContinue")
Verify the confirm screen is visible (id "SpendingConfirmMore") and wait until its network fee is shown
Note the amounts under "Network Fees" and "Total"
Run in one command: ../bitkit-android/lsp POST /regtest/chain/deposit '{"address":"<savings addr>","amountSat":500000}' && ../bitkit-android/lsp POST /regtest/chain/mine '{"count":1}'
Wait 30s for the wallet to sync the new UTXO
If the received sheet (id "ReceivedTransaction") is visible, tap its button (id "ReceivedTransactionButton")
Verify the confirm screen still shows the amounts noted before the deposit
Swipe the "Swipe To Transfer" handle (id "GRAB") fully to the right
Wait up to 90s for the setting up screen (id "LightningSettingUp")
